headline: coverage-confounded, do not read as censorship change: data_darkness, ddti_novelty
method: for each signal with a recorded sample size: robust (MAD) z of the metric and of its denominator, then least-squares metric ~ a + b*denominator over the reference readings and the latest residual scored against reference residuals. CONFIRMED when the departure survives conditioning (>= 0.5 of the raw z and >= 2); COVERAGE_CONFOUNDED when it does not; INCONCLUSIVE when the fit cannot support either call
caveats: conditioning is linear and the histories are short — the fit correlation and pair count are published with every verdict, and |r| < 0.3 is treated as uninformative rather than as licence to conclude
CONFIRMED rules out the COVERAGE confound specifically, not every confound; it is not a causal claim about censorship
signals whose sample size is not recorded in their history cannot be guarded at all and are absent here rather than assumed clean
